name: Nanagane Gakuen -Ryokou Bu-
source:
Main character Kei Tokisaka, is a second year student attending a travel club. He is an ordinary student, but he has a secret that he can't tell anyone about. He adores club members who are all beautiful girls: the beautiful head of the club, the idol girl, the honor student's childhood friend, and cute younger students. The life of the club is filled with excitement, anxiety, humor and romance.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2022/01/vn-of-month-december-2021-kunado-kokuki.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角Kei Tokisaka，是加入旅行社團的二年級學生。他看似普通，卻藏著一個無法對任何人言說的秘密。他十分喜歡社團裡的成員，而她們清一色都是美少女，有美麗的社長、偶像少女、成績優異的青梅竹馬，以及可愛的學妹。社團生活充滿興奮、不安、歡笑與浪漫。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2022/01/vn-of-month-december-2021-kunado-kokuki.html]vndbreview[/url]]
